summary.text: Elesh Norn sets the Phyrexian invasion in motion from New Phyrexia, summoning portals to five planes where Realmbreaker's limbs anchor and release pods of Phyrexian forces.
The story follows Chandra, who refuses to abandon the people stuck on New Phyrexia and sets out with Wrenn to take down the World Tree, only to find that Norn knew about the resistance all along.
Meanwhile the invaded worlds fight back as they can, from the united longships of Kaldheim to Huatli calling the elder dinosaurs of Ixalan, with the survival of each plane at stake.
